schema.title: Jupytext
schema.description: List of Jupytext Text Notebook formats that will be added to launcher and jupytext menu.

auto:percent.title: Text Notebook as Script in Percent Format

auto:light.title: Text Notebook as Script in Light Format

auto:hydrogen.title: Text Notebook as Script in Hydrogen Format

auto:nomarker.title: Text Notebook as Script in Nomarker Format

NOTE.description: Refresh the current browser tab for the changes to take effect.

schema.title: Claude Code Sessions
schema.description: Settings for the Claude Code sessions side panel.

presentationMode.title: Presentation mode
presentationMode.description: How session rows are labelled. `session` (default) shows the user-set session name from /rename, falling back to the project folder name. `folder` always shows the project folder name. `path` shows the project path relative to the JupyterLab notebook root (absolute if outside it).

recentLimit.title: Recent items count
recentLimit.description: Number of rows shown in the Recent section, sorted by last activity (descending).

dangerouslySkipPermissions.title: Dangerously skip permissions
dangerouslySkipPermissions.description: When enabled, newly spawned and resumed sessions are launched with `--dangerously-skip-permissions`. Bypasses every Claude Code permission prompt - only enable in sandboxes you trust.

enabled.title: Enable markdown-it Markdown renderer
enabled.description: Use markdown-it for new renderers. Re-open existing documents to see changes.

disabled-plugins.title: Disabled plugins
disabled-plugins.description: markdown-it plugins to disable for new renderers. Re-open existing documents to see changes.

markdown-it-options.title: MarkdownIt options
markdown-it-options.description: Advanced. JSON-compatible override options to MarkdownIt. https://markdown-it.github.io/markdown-it/#MarkdownIt.new

plugin-options.title: markdown-it plugin options. See individual plugins for options.
plugin-options.description: Advanced. List of positional JSON-compatible options to pass to the named plugin.

root.description: Root path used for filtering out favorites from instances of JupyterLab launched in a different root directory. If not given the favorite will be shown if the associated file exists.

showWidget.description: Toggles the favorites widget above the filebrowser breadcrumbs.
showWidget.title: Show Widget

showStarsOnCells.title: Show Stars on Cells
showStarsOnCells.description: Controls the visibility of star icons on cells.

sortOrder.title: Sort Order
sortOrder.description: How to sort favorites in the list.

groupByType.title: Group by Type
groupByType.description: Group directories before files when sorting.

synctex.title: SyncTeX
synctex.description: Whether to use SyncTeX for linking document views

accessToken.title: A GitHub Personal Access Token
accessToken.description: WARNING: For security reasons access tokens should be set in the server extension.

saveState.title: Save Jupyter widget state in notebooks
saveState.description: Automatically save Jupyter widget state when a notebook is saved.
